snippet.title: Archons - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
We're excited to show you our first game, Archons!
Try the Demo for free Today.
DEMO: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3192850/Archons_Demo

Archons is a Roguelite/Survivor where you control two characters, the Archons. Upgrade your Archons with different weapons to blast your way through the hordes of parasites and gigantic bosses. Customize your upgrades to build your own unique playstyle.

WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2779570/Archons

Developed by BulletHell Studios

Music by Olivier Orand.
https://www.olivierorand.com/

Find out more:
https://bullethellstudios.com/
